name: vayuguardian-ai
description: VayuGuardian AI — Hyperlocal Urban Clean Air Defense & Vulnerable Care Microclimate System for Hack2Skill Challenge 6

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(h => { const fs = import('fs'); const s = h.createServer((req,res) => { let p = req.url === '/' ? '/index.html' : req.url; let ct = p.endsWith('.css') ? 'text/css' : (p.endsWith('.js') ? 'application/javascript' : (p.endsWith('.svg') ? 'image/svg+xml' : (p.endsWith('.json') ? 'application/json' : 'text/html'))); fs.then(f => f.readFile('.' + p, (err,data) => { if(err){ res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } else { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': ct}); res.end(data); } })); }); s.listen(3000, () => console.log('🍃 VayuGuardian AI running at http://localhost:3000')); })"

author: Vishwajeet Kumar (VishwajeetCSE)
